# WOLFE

Source: https://github.com/ariannamethod/wolfe

Commit: `a04d2b7e6488656b715ca6b5b5ef5b1227eea79d`

License: GPL-3.0, included in `LICENSE`.

Two local changes in `wolfe.c`:

- Hebrew polarity: `לא`, `אל`, and the `לא רק` exception join the existing clause feature.
- Longer enum aliases own overlapping spans across properties: `כל היום` supplies a full period without also supplying today.
